entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello, David. I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's for Sarah Jenkins, order number is VF88712. I just... I really need to send it back.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it works fine. It's just... I feel a bit silly saying it, but I just **changed my mind**. It was a total **impulse buy** around the holidays, and honestly, I **don't use it** like I thought I would. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really hope you can help. I was counting on getting that money back.
I understand completely, Sarah. No problem at all. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Alright, I've got it here. It looks like your purchase was made 21 days ago. Our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! I was so worried I'd waited too long. Thank you so much, David. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've made my day. I really appreciate your help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
